title: Real embedding of the binary encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $x$ be a vector in the $n$-dimensional cube over the field with two elements. The real-valued embedding of the binary encoding of $f$, evaluated at $x$, equals one half of $1$ minus the real value of $f$ at the corresponding sign vector.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
A vector $x$ in the $n$-dimensional cube over the field with two elements
